configuration.subset_independence: separate independent SRSWOR streams by corpus and kind; overlap is retained
configuration.record_frame: all unique admitted records in complete logged core R/S/U/A checkpoint union
configuration.checkpoint_rule: one uniformly seeded actual occurrence independently fixed per record and audit kind
configuration.nearest_rule: all surviving selected records at chosen checkpoint EXCLUDING query; largest reference cosine, stable ID tie
configuration.context_limit_units: Unicode code points, not model tokens
configuration.missing_or_scarce: no refill, no other-corpus transfer, no replacement for truncation, empty comparison, skip or uncertainty
